verdict.rationale: Persona documents native iOS, Android and React Native SDKs, plus an Embedded Flow for web, and it runs Government ID verification. That covers the SDK half of the story. Nothing in the evidence describes guided camera capture or real-time coaching for glare, blur or edge detection. Missing for 10: documented glare/blur/edge detection capture coaching, evidence of first-try usable document photo rates, a dedicated native web SDK beyond an iframe/modal embed, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I get native iOS, Android, and web SDKs with guided camera capture — glare, blur, and edge detection coaching the user to a usable document photo on the first try

citations.quote: Mobile SDKs | Native iOS, Android, and React Native libraries | Mobile apps, optimal device signals
The most comprehensive way to integrate Persona is to setup an Embedded Flow for web or integrate with one of our Mobile SDKs
Embedded Flow | Persona UI embedded in your page via iframe or modal | Seamless UX on your site
A Government Id Verification answers the question "Does the individual possess a genuine Government Issued Identity that supports their claim to a physical identity?"
